text.en: Podenco is an operator who applied to join Rhodes Island through a normal process, and is responsible for taking care of the greenhouse and cultivating flowers in Perfumer's Convalescent Garden. Can also be deployed as a combat operator and is capable of utilizing her understanding of plants to heal teammates or disrupt enemies.
text.zh: 波登可是以普通流程应聘进入罗德岛的干员，在调香师主管的庭院里负责照看温室与花卉培植。可以作为作战干员调动，运用对植物的理解医疗队友或扰乱敌人。

text.en:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected. 

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Operator Podenco has no signs of Originium infections. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.13u/L
Operator Podenco has very little contact with Originium. 

'That scent, it's so good... So refreshing... Ah, ah... Achoo!' —A medic operator with a pollen allergy
text.zh:
造影检测结果显示，该干员体内脏器轮廓清晰，未见异常阴影，循环系统内源石颗粒检测未见异常，无矿石病感染迹象，现阶段可确认为非矿石病感染者。

【体细胞与源石融合率】0%
干员波登可没有被源石感染的迹象。

【血液源石结晶密度】0.13u/L
干员波登可甚少接触源石。

“好香，啊啊真香，真好闻，啊，啊——阿嚏！” ——某位花粉过敏的医疗干员

text.en: Podenco was born into a small settlement on the steppes near the border of Bolívar. While this remote settlement was able to escape the flames of war due to its distance from the center of Bolívar, this isolation also created its own problems. To ensure their survival, the people of this settlement delved into their natural talents at evading Catastrophes and cultivating crops. Podenco has been interested in a variety of plants since a young age, likes to make dried flowers, and also tended a small nursery back home. As she grew up, she became involved in the community's farming efforts, gaining rich experience in botanical cultivation for plants both edible and ornamental. When asked which type of plants she prefers, Podenco will quietly tell you that she likes flowers more, but when food and clothing become a scarcity, she will silently stash away her personal preferences deep into her heart.
text.zh: 波登可出生在玻利瓦尔边境高原的小聚落中。这支聚落由于远离玻利瓦尔中心而得以躲避战乱，但由此也引发了新的问题。为了保证生存，这支聚落发掘了族人在躲避天灾和培育作物上的才能。波登可从小就对各种植物感兴趣，喜欢制作干花，也懂得呵护家中的小苗圃，当稍长大一点后，就开始参与进聚落的作物培植工作中，在此期间，波登可积累了非常丰富的植物培植经验，这些植物中有可食的，也有可观赏的。硬要说波登可喜欢哪种多一点，她会悄悄告诉你她更喜欢花卉，但在当时温饱都成问题的情况下，她还是默默将这份喜好压在了心底。

text.en: Not everyone who lives in these remote regions aspires to lead a bustling life in a distant land, but Podenco was one such person who did. The people of her home had little contact with the outside world, but the interactions they did have gradually gave Podenco a rosy impression of the outside world, particularly towards flowers. She had seen all kinds of flora in the world depicted through books and photos, but someone who never left Bolívar would never be able to see these flowers in their entire life. Within her stirred a great anticipation to see the outside world.
text.zh: 不是每个生活在偏远地区的人都会向往远方的繁华生活，但波登可还是十分向往的，从族人们对外界接触后留在闲谈中的只言片语，波登可的记忆中渐渐显现出对于外面世界的美好印象，特别是花，她在书籍和图册中见到了各式各样生长在天南地北的花朵，而这些花，待在玻利瓦尔是一辈子都无法见到的。她开始对外面的世界充满期待。

text.en:
After arriving at Rhodes Island, her becoming Perfumer's coworker and apprentice was actually by chance. The young Podenco, like a fledgling leaving the nest, was completely spellbound by the magnificence of the city after arriving at the closest nomadic city from her hometown. She couldn't wait to find some place filled with fragrance and beauty, and soon after, she bumped into Perfumer in the middle of the street. Perfumer immediately noticed Podenco's fondness for flowers, and her own Garden happened to be short of the personnel needed to make her aromatherapy raw materials. And just like that, Podenco ran into someone by mistake, and landed herself the first job of her life. 
Compared to Perfumer, Podenco still is lacking in many ways. Her sense of smell isn't as sensitive as Perfumer's, nor does she have any knowledge of auxiliary professions, but she is quickly approaching Perfumer's skill with the momentum she has. From a single flower, to a garden, and now to an entire greenhouse, Podenco has the skill to independently manage the Convalescent Garden. In addition, she also began to use the flowers she collected to create a wide variety of reagents, constantly adapting to meet the demands of the various medics in the medical facility. In time, she may well become the world's undisputed master of horticulture. 
And it all stems from her love for flowers. 
A lifelong love.
text.zh:
来到罗德岛，成为调香师的同事兼学徒其实完全是一场意外。初出茅庐的波登可在来到离群落最近的移动城市后，完全被城市的壮丽抓住了眼球，她迫不及待地寻找充满芬芳与美好的地方，然后就在路中央和调香师撞了个满怀。调香师察觉了她对花卉的喜爱，而疗养庭院也正缺人手栽种芬芳疗法必要的原料，就这样，波登可误打误撞，获得了人生中的第一份工作。
和调香师相比，波登可在许多领域上都还无法企及。她没有调香师那么灵敏的嗅觉，对于一些辅助专业也完全没有概念，但是凭借着一股冲劲，她正在慢慢向调香师靠近。从一朵花、一片花圃、到一座温室，现在的波登可已经有着独立管理疗养庭院部分设施的能力了。此外，她还开始用自己采集的花卉尝试制作各式各样的试剂，不断适应医疗部对于庭院的委托。有朝一日，她或许能够成为独当一面的花卉大师。
一切只是因为喜爱。
热忱的喜爱。

text.en:
'Podenco's Greenhouse - Production Commission Details' 
We can make floral tea, which is best enjoyed in the greenhouse. 
With a flower purse, you can always carry a soothing fragrance with you. 
Experience better rest with a flower pillow (please allow extra time for production). 
Come enjoy my flower biscuits, but please supply all the ingredients other than the flowers. 
Please discuss with me if you would like to request any other items, and I will see if there is a possibility of making it. 
There are many combinations of the above items to choose from. Please contact me for further details.
text.zh:
《波登可的温室——制作委托明细》
可以做花茶，在温室里喝最好啦。
可以做花包，随身带着香香的很舒服。
可以做花枕，制作时间可能会比较长，但效果一定好。
可以做花饼，请自带花以外的原料过来。
其他有什么想到的物品可以详谈，如果有可能性的话会尝试制作。
以上皆有复数组合可供选择，详情请咨询波登可哦。
